next_step: Start 2-week Hosted API POC (streaming + tool-calling) — schedule kickoff; security deep-dive w/ infra team
notes:
Account summary: Northstar Agentive builds AI-first conversational assistants for mid-market SaaS (help centers + billing flows). Interested in Redwood for predictable latency and streaming tool-calls to their CRM and billing backend.

Discovery highlights:
- Primary driver: reduce live-agent load by ~35% with reliable tool-invocation from agent flows.
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile first-token < 350ms, steady-state streaming token latency consistent; end-to-end agent invocation (model + tool call) < 700ms typical.
- Throughput: peak expected 40-80 concurrent active conversations during weekday peak; batch/off-peak higher.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market; POC must show cost per 1M tokens comparable to current benchmarks.

Security & compliance notes (critical):
- They will run initial POC on Hosted API but require SOC2 Type II attestation and explicit confirmation that Redwood hosted control plane does not retain PII by default.
- Must support SSO/SAML for console access and scoped API keys for app environments.
- KMS integration required for Dedicated option; for Hosted they want KMS for key-wrapping or an equivalent assurance.
- Retention: default logs should be 30–90 days configurable; they require ability to redact PII from logs or to opt out of request/response logging for specific routes.
- Request: sample redaction flow and example audit log entries.

POC plan (agreed verbally 2026-03-03):
- 2-week POC on Hosted API: implement streaming chat endpoint + tool calling to mock billing API. Provide sample prompt templates and rollout suggestions.
- Success criteria: meet 95p first-token latency <350ms, tool call success rate >99%, and end-to-end error rate <0.5%.
- Deliverables from Redwood: onboarding guide, streaming example, tool-calling sample, token-level cost estimation, metrics dashboard access.

Commercial & roadmap notes:
- They like the Hosted experience for speed-to-value; Dedicated becomes relevant if SLA + VPC required after POC.
- Estimated ARR band discussed: $60k–$180k ARR depending on whether Dedicated is adopted and retention add-ons.
- Pricing conversation: requested a committed monthly seat/throughput discount scenario and clear burst pricing.

Quotes / call paraphrases:
- CTO: "We cannot have customer PII living in plaintext in logs — redaction or no-logs mode is a must."
- Head of Product: "Streaming with tool calls is the differentiator for our UX; if latency stutters we lose customers."

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-14: first inbound contact from Head of Product (lead form).
- 2026-02-19: Discovery call with Maya, Arjun — use cases and SSO/security checklist.
- 2026-02-26: Technical deep-dive (Fireflies ff_2026-02-26_01) — validated streaming + tool-calling architecture.
- 2026-03-03: Commercial intro, rough ARR band, agreed POC scope.
- 2026-03-09: Security touchpoint with Buyer procurement; requested SOC2 report, redaction examples, and DPA draft.

Next steps (short):
- Send Hosted API POC instructions & sample code by 2026-03-13.
- Schedule security deep-dive w/ Redwood security (Arjun, Maya, Northstar infra) for week of 2026-03-22.
- Provide Dedicated pricing scenario and commitment tiers for procurement review.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Exact retention policy they will accept for logs if redaction is incomplete.
- Whether they will require on-prem / air-gapped deployment for regulated customers later (long-term).
- Final procurement cadence — likely 6–10 weeks after POC based on procurement feedback.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Prioritize sample PII redaction config + include an example of disabling request logs per route.
- Provide latency benchmark files for models recommended for streaming (include 95p numbers on comparable workloads).
- Prepare Dedicated VPC + KMS one-pager for procurement to compare vs Hosted controls.

CRM shorthand: POC signed off w/ VP Product; security is gating factor. Keep comms high-touch.
